notes: 'to day' is read as one English word written in two tokens, shared by the article and יוֹם under rule 30 and headed on the noun; the same חַ elsewhere in the verse takes the written 'this' under rule 41.
'seeing' is added under rule 55: no conjunction stands in the clause אַתֶּם תִּמְרְדוּ.
The apodosis waw carries the presentative frame's 'that' under rule 45.
